The exact integer-base census is (0,0), (2,0), (0,2), (1,0), (0,1), (1,1). Vertex extremality leaves each short interval unchanged. At a midpoint only the same edge can contribute and its endpoint coefficients agree; the corresponding averaged endpoint interval [0,1/2] is inside [0,1]. The projection is Q, and the three base vertices at height zero plus one at height 1/2 give full dimension. All generators are rational.

The three vertices occupy parity (0,0); the three midpoints occupy the other parities. There is no interior integer base in Q and each edge has one in its relative interior. Each edge has length sum 2. If a convex subpiece has only one occupied positive-length parity, two positive endpoint sections would force a positive midpoint section of another parity, so at most one section contributes and its length is at most 1. With two occupied parities the length sum is at most 2. The full edge gives equality.

For any containing closed halfspace, the trace of a captured mark's fiber contains a one-sided interval of at least its own depth, or is the whole interval when the continuous normal vanishes. Summing over disjoint fibers gives mu(H)≥nu_x(H) for every H, including endpoint marks with weight zero.

A pure base cap isolates each vertex so its atomic depth is at most 1/4. Exact face isolation reduces any midpoint calculation to its three edge marks. If they are noncollinear the midpoint-base mark is exposed in their triangle and can be cut out alone, giving depth equal to its weight at most 1/2.

In the collinear case the midpoint-base mark is the midpoint of the two other marks, so x_0=(x_-+x_+)/2≤1/2 and t_0=x_0. Closed halfspaces through this mark can retain it and either endpoint alone, and every containing halfspace retains at least one endpoint. Thus its exact depth is t_0+min(t_-,t_+)≤x_0+1/2−max(x_-,x_+)≤1/2. Zero endpoint weights and equal heights are allowed in this argument.

The center selection gives midpoint own weight 1/2, hence containing caps have at least that mass and attain the optimized bound by the upper estimate. Independently recomputed the source length 9/2 and target (9/2)/8=9/16>1/2.
